answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Stave shaper ash stave mark entered in the stave yard book — each ash stave is an iron hoop pressed beside the coopers mark, so a farm must shape. The farm's edge dies on cost: 454 separate proofs, each 104 POA, totalling 47216 POA before a single answer counts. The terrace is the evidence, the plume is the expense, and the raven is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
